name: Instrumentl
description: Instrumentl integration for nonprofits. Make Instrumentl a native part of your AI workflow — an intelligent partner that helps you find, win, and manage grants faster, directly in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Instrumentl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Instrumentl to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.instrumentl.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Instrumentl MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Instrumentl provides these MCP tools: get_current_account, get_grant, get_match, list_grants, list_project_matches, and list_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Instrumentl?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Instrumentl in nonprofit on the Manufact MCP catalog include Granted, hacesfalta, Benevity, Candid, and Chariot.
Instrumentl requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Instrumentl is developed by Instrumentl. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
